verdict.rationale: Official docs describe a Cloud Backup toggle. It stores account data in a chosen Microsoft personal account, or in iCloud on iOS, so that after losing a phone or getting a new device you can sign in and restore your saved accounts. One community report says an app update wiped all data and locked the user out, but it does not show the backup/restore path itself failing, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: step-by-step restore details on the new device, whether restored work/school accounts need re-verification, cross-platform (iOS↔Android) restore behavior, and independent hands-on confirmation that restore works.
